bio: Neon Miami 80s: white suits, palm trees, ocean drives and city lights in pink and teal. Retro-crime mood, zero violence.
avatar: Portrait of a stylish man in his late 30s with slicked-back hair and aviator sunglasses wearing a pastel suit jacket, pink and teal neon light on his face, neon Miami 80s style, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a neon Miami 80s skyline at dusk with palm trees, a pink and teal sky and a vintage sports car on an ocean drive, subject across the middle band, cinematic, no text
